body:
This is the first time I've done a report mainly because I'm not an experienced drug user. However, I feel the need to share my experiences in the case of this stuff. I was at a party when I had it, a mate of mine had told me about it as he bought some (off the net) and had already tried some saying the effects were nuts in a  good way, so although it was an experimental drug I thought what the heck!
[Erowid Note:

See

.]
I had been drinking quite a bit something like 10 pints and a few shots of sambuca, so was feeling a bit tipsy. Anyway went with my mate and we both sniffed up about 60mg (I reckon it was about that much not 100% as we didn't weigh it obviously), now I've never tried ket but the 'come-up' to me was a bit like MDMA in a way (previous drugs I've tried are Cocaine, MDMA and weed - so not alot), it was quite a nice feeling tingling through the body although it happened within about 5-10mins of consumption which took me by surprise! Considering when I did my first MDMA bomb (130mg) I didn't even come-up after an hour and double dipped which ended up being really intense!
Anyway, it couldn't have been more than a few minutes after that I was pretty much in another world, although able to hold a conversation with people somehow. After about 3-4hours everyone started to leave but I didn't notice anyone leave, it was like they were there one minute and just gone the next. This is when a slight feeling of loneliness came over me although there were a few people still around, not a great feeling tbh, so I went outside to chill out and just fell flat on my face (just lost all ability to balance). Got back up had a cigarette and went back inside and then a little bit later I started to come back to reality. It must have been about 5 hours after initial consumption although it only felt like an hour had passed.
Its kind of hard to explain that last part of the trip just before and after going outside, but it did kind of feel like I was dead but thinking back its more like severe confusion - you just can't comprehend anything and being by myself was probably not a good idea, since I am not experienced with dissociatives. I'd like to mention my mate took some more about an hour later (I think he took about 80-100mg cause I saw him sniff 2 lines), he was really fucked after that just saying 'no its not right' and then making weird crying/laughing sounds. Comforted him for a bit and he calmed down after about an hour.
Anyway this isn't as good as some other reports but thought I'd pass my experience on as a novice user.  After effects the next day were a very spaced out feeling and everything looking surreal. Oh and my head feeling like it was going to explode but that was the alcohol!
